item.title: Farm Life Add-On
item.creator: PixelHeads
item.description:
Welcome to Farm Life! Plant a huge variety of crops, care for animals, cook delicious new foods, build vehicles, decorate your farm, and use tractors and tools to expand your land. Trade your harvest, team up with helpful NPCs, and grow your own countryside farm!

53+ Crops
36+ Animals
528+ Decoration Blocks
12+ Tractor Attachments
11+ Vehicles
188+ Food Blocks
13+ NPCs
item.changelog:
Fixes & Improvements
- Wooden decorative blocks break faster with an axe
- Hats can now be equipped from the hotbar
- Fixed placed food, Tall Corral Gate transparency, and farmer feeding/breeding
- Restored feeding heart particles
- Vehicle sounds 30% quieter
- Various fixes for better stability

faqEntries.heading: What is Farm Life about?
faqEntries.content: Farm Life is an add-on focused on building and managing your own farm, growing crops, raising animals, producing food, and expanding your farm over time.

faqEntries.heading: Is Farm Life only about growing crops?
faqEntries.content: No. Farming is a big part of it, but the add-on also includes vehicles, cooking, decoration, and many other activities.

faqEntries.heading: What can I learn while playing Farm Life?
faqEntries.content: Farm Life introduces players to different crops, farm animals, food production, and some of the basic processes involved in running a farm.

faqEntries.heading: Can I build my own farm however I want?
faqEntries.content: Yes. Farm Life is designed to give you the tools and content to create and develop your own farm in whatever way you prefer.

faqEntries.heading: What can Farm Life teach players about the value of work?
faqEntries.content: Farm Life encourages players to understand the value of effort and reward. NPC workers can help with different tasks, but their work must be fairly rewarded, introducing the idea that time, effort, and work have value.

faqEntries.heading: Does Farm Life help players understand the value of farming?
faqEntries.content: Yes. Through its farming and economy systems, Farm Life gives players a simple way to experience the work behind producing food, earning from what they create, and reinvesting those rewards to continue developing their farm.

howToEntries.heading: Getting Started
howToEntries.content: Upon spawning in a world with the add-on enabled you will receive a guide book, a settings item and some coins. The guide book is your introduction into the add-on teaching you everything you need to know about the Farm Life Add-On. The settings item can be used to turn off or on the music.
